mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MYBATIS_REQUEST ( TITLE, CONTENTS, TEST_TYPE, REQUEST_DATE, REQUESTER_ID, STATUS ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{contents}, #{testType}, #{requestDate}, #{requesterId}, #{status} )
